reuse.why: Hooks the new guard into the existing shared linkBankAccount entry point that every provider link already goes through, next to the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard.

duplication.why: One guard, one call; nothing is repeated per provider.

placement.why: The guard sits beside the other link guard in accounts/app.ts and runs at the start of the shared link flow, before any write or sync.

scope.why: Focused on the closed-account rule; no tests accompany the new behaviour.

maintainability.why: Small, well-named guard in the single link path; the account row is read again by upsertLinkedAccount, a negligible cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared linkBankAccount flow; no provider-specific checks.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotClosed called once from linkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, which all provider link handlers use.
